summary: Implemented a verified-provider-only commission projection backed by a resolver-owned read model. The projection is strict and read-only, preserves explicit source/effective timestamp/version/value semantics, returns source none when no active commission exists, enforces subject ownership, and strips resolver and administrative identifiers.
